senses.gloss: (with ידא) to rub, whence to wash and dry, esp. one’s hands before and after meals.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 107a:1">Ḥull. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>מְשׁוּ ידייכו וכ׳</he> wash your hands in the morning.
<cite ref="Chullin 46b">Ib. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>ולא מְשִׁית ידיך</he> (not <he>ידיה</he>) and didst not wash thy hands.
<cite ref="Chullin 46b">Ib.</cite> <he>ואנא מָשֵׁינָא</he> and I should wash? <cite ref="Pesachim 112a:1">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 91a:8">Ned. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>מַשְׁיָא ידיה וכ׳</he> she washed her husband’s hands.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 52b:2">Kidd. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>מַשְׁיָא כרעא וכ׳</he> was washing a foot in a basin of water.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 153a:10">B. Bath. 153ᵃ</cite>. <he>אַמְשִינְהוּ … במיא</he> they drew Raba’s clothes through water.
